lines: The new season, for some reason, brings aching days
I chased after you, pedaling your bike along the riverside path
With records full of memories and exaggerated stories
Swinging from your tired shoulders, scowling yet radiant
The same lines, the same moment, as if they'd slip out of our mouths
With this ordinary magic, we built it up
A country for just the two of us, where no one can touch us
So I won't let go of your hand
If we lift it with great strength and set it floating in the sky
Lulala, we ride the wind of space
Even the cat abandoned in a corner, still refusing to stop breathing
Looks somehow like us — I scoop it up and press it against my cheek
The round window I gazed up at from our usual crossing
And the grimy, barely-there crescent moon was watching me too
At the edge of the dream where I lay in wait — your startled eyes
And now, here, we are born again
A country for just the two of us, where no one can touch us
Scattering songs that never end
If we lift it with great strength and set it floating in the sky
Lulala, we ride the wind of space
